Estera

Biography

Estera is a witch living apart from the village with her granddaughter Airy the Stubborn. Traps guard the approach to her cave. Gruff and suspicious at first, she welcomes Zak after he brings her a Magic Bit, but refuses to accept the villagers’ story that he is simply a divinely sent saviour. [1, 2, 3]

An ally in the search

Estera interprets the orc records that trace the Magic Orb to the Dead City, explains the city’s history and helps uncover the plot against Zak. She can freeze the lake for the journey to the dragon. Her protective anger resurfaces when Airy disappears, and she asks Zak to bring her granddaughter home. Naya the Secretive is her apprentice. [4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]
